  "number": 111,
  "title": "[Claude] Host Control slice C: native link listener and Shell Host Control screen",
  "body": "Slice C of `docs/adr/0004-host-control-sliced-delivery.md`. Depends on slice A (#109) for the payload, fixtures and getter name; parallel with slice B (#110). **Size: L.** Tier: `full`. Choices are decisions you can overturn.

## Shell

- **Shell Host Control Entry:** a new row after the Shell Upload Entry, captioned `Linked: <name>` or `Not linked`. Confirm opens the screen.
- **Shell Host Control Screen** (`VD_SHELL_HOST_CONTROL`): entering it starts the listener. It shows `Link address: 192.168.1.177:8798`, a hint to give it to the Host Companion's `link`, and a status line (waiting, bind error, or `Linked to <name> at <url>`). Cross on `Forget link` clears the link with no confirm step, since relinking is cheap.
- **Listener lifetime**, per the ADR: it stops when a link succeeds, on Circle (back to Home), on Start (Shell hides), and on exit (`shell_shutdown`). Runtime Upload is untouched, and both listeners can run at once.
- **Input:** no new keys, and `src/ui/input.c` is unchanged. In `CONTEXT.md`, **Shell Face Input** gains "Circle leaves the Host Control screen".

## Shared HTTP parsing

- No picohttpparser. `src/upload/http_parse.*` moves into `src/net/http.{c,h}`, together with `read_request`, `send_response`, `send_json_error` and the drain helpers from `http_server.c`. Upload behaves exactly as before.
- LAN address detection moves into `src/platform/`: `lan_address_posix.c` uses `getifaddrs` and `lan_address_vita.c` uses `sceNetCtl`.
- The ADR's case-sensitive header defect is already fixed on `main` (`strncasecmp`, covered by `upload_parsing_harness`). Rewrite that ADR sentence in place.

## Listener, store, getter

- **`src/host_control/listener.c`** binds 8798. It falls forward up to 10 ports (safe, since the address is on screen) and stays clear of upload (8787–8796) and the companion (8797) on one Mac. One accept thread handles connections inline with a 2 s receive timeout, and the only route is `POST /link`. The Shell polls it the way it polls upload.
- **`src/host_control/link.c`** holds `host_control_link_parse`, a pure jimp parser. It accepts `protocolVersion == 1`, an `http://` `url` of at most 255 bytes with no spaces or control bytes, and a `name` of 1 to 64 bytes. It also keeps the mutex-guarded current link in `<data root>/host-control-link.json`, saved with `deck_app_storage`'s Vita-safe replace. The newest link wins, and forgetting deletes the file.
- **`src/jslib/host_control.c`** registers `nativeGetHostControlUrl(): string` (`""` when unlinked) and declares it in `runtime-native.d.ts`. Reads are live, so a running Deck App's next command uses the new link.

## Vita vs host

Sockets, `vd_thread` and `package_library_data_root()` already cover both; the LAN address is the only new platform code. `full` proves the Vita build; ask Máté before hardware testing.

## Tests

`tests/host_control_link_harness.c` (CTest):

- Slice A's `link-*.json` fixtures run through the parser.
- Store round trip: save, reload, forget.
- Loopback: start the listener, POST a fixture with lowercase headers, and assert the reply, the stored URL, and that the listener stopped.

Upload harnesses keep passing; one manual host-window pass, with screenshots in the PR.

**Docs:** `CONTEXT.md` (both Shell terms above, **Host Control Link Listener**, Shell Home Screen), the ADR sentence, and `AGENTS.md` "Where code lives".

**Files:** `src/net/`, `src/upload/http_server.c`, `src/platform/lan_address*`, `src/host_control/`, `src/jslib/{host_control,jslib}.c`, `src/shell/shell.{c,h}`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `tests/host_control_link_harness.c`, `js/packages/runtime/src/runtime-native.d.ts`.

Posted by Claude Code [claude-opus-5-5]
